label: 100 nm beads, widefield 40×/0.95 (81 planes)
description: TetraSpeck beads imaged through a 40×/0.95 air objective on an EVOS M5000 widefield microscope (Miora, Senftleben & Abrahamsson, Zenodo 10522322, CC BY 4.0): 512 × 512 × 81, 0.126 µm pixels, 0.133 µm z step.
expectedResult: About 60 beads detected; the well-fitted ones give lateral FWHM near 0.38 µm (1.4 × the 0.28 µm theory) and axial near 2.3 µm, flagged at over 2 × the 1.03 µm theory.

label: Synthetic field illumination (640 × 480)
description: Synthetic: an off-centre Gaussian illumination profile with Poisson noise, a stand-in for an image of a uniform fluorescent slide. It demonstrates the metrics, not a real microscope.
expectedResult: Uniformity 45.0 %, field uniformity 88.1 % and centering accuracy 91.4 %, with the 90–100 % zone right of and above the centre.
